datasheet.revision_or_date: Revision table: REV 1.0 'Preliminary Release' Dec-15-2022; outline drawing REV A (Feb-22-2022, DWN Dec-20-22); PDF modified 2023-06-28. A 'rev B' could NOT be found or confirmed: the live buydisplay URL is behind a Cloudflare challenge and the newest archived copy (2025-01-09) is this one. An older archived copy (PDF 2023-02-08) differs only in DOTCLK unused level (IOVCC vs DGND) and LED Vf (3.0/3.2 vs 3.2/3.4 V).

facts: §2.1: 'FPC Connector: 50 Pin 0.5mm Pitch Bottom Contact ZIF Connector'

§3.1 front view (display side, FPC unfolded below the glass edge): exposed contacts drawn facing the viewer, numbered 50 on the left ... 1 on the right; backlight test pads 'K6K5K4K3K2K1A' and the FPC neck sit at the pin-1 (right) side
§3.1 rear view: the PI stiffener ('FPC+PI补强=0.3±0.03MM') is on the back, numbered 1 left ... 50 right (mirror), so the contacts are on the FRONT face of the unfolded tail

Folding the tail 180 deg behind the panel about the edge axis keeps x and flips the face: contacts now face away from the panel, i.e. DOWN onto the PCB = bottom contact, and panel pin 1 stays at +x (right, seen from above)

Board: case/positions.json glass y 56.88-143.12, fpc_zones reach y=143 -> FPC leaves the +y (seat 1) edge; J3 at (100,120.89) rot 0, mouth +y; case.scad: neck centre +3.6 mm (right), consistent with the datasheet front view
KiCad Hirose_FH12-50S-0.5SH footprint: pad 1 at x=-12.25 (left), pad 50 at +12.25, tails at -y, mouth +y; FH12 datasheet p.4 top view has the polarizing (pin-1) mark at the left with tails up
fpc_orientation.conclusion: Contact at x=-12.25+0.5(j-1) mates with panel contact 51-j: J3 pin j = panel pin 51-j is CORRECT. This follows from pad geometry alone (independent of Hirose's own pin-1 naming).
